title: Deductible Schedule — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Deductible Schedule — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

Building and contents deductibles on NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) are elected separately, from the amounts listed for the tier, and the two may differ. The schedule below gives, for every tier, the elective amounts, the minimums, the threshold that decides which building minimum applies, the defaults taken when an application elects nothing, and the ceiling.

| Item | Tenant Contents | Residential Condominium Unit | Manufactured Home | Secondary Single-Family Home | Primary Single-Family Home | Two-to-Four Unit Building |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Building deductible amounts that may be elected (USD) | none | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 |
| Contents deductible amounts that may be elected (USD) | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 | 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 10000 |
| Minimum building deductible when the building limit is at or below the deductible threshold (USD; 0 where building coverage is unavailable) | 0 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Minimum building deductible when the building limit exceeds the deductible threshold (USD; 0 where building coverage is unavailable) | 0 | 1250 | 1250 | 1250 | 1250 | 1250 |
| Deductible threshold: building limit at or below which the lower minimum deductible applies (USD) | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 |
| Minimum contents deductible (USD) | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Building deductible applied when the application elects none (USD; 0 where building coverage is unavailable) | 0 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 |
| Contents deductible applied when the application elects none (USD) | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 | 2000 |
| Highest deductible that may be elected on either coverage (USD) | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 |

### Notes on the schedule

- On the **NFIP Dwelling Form – Tenant Contents** tier no building deductible exists: the list of elective building amounts is empty and every building minimum and default is 0.
- On every other tier the building minimum is 1000 dollars when the building limit is at or below the threshold of 100000 dollars, and 1250 dollars when the building limit is above 100000 dollars. A hypothetical building limit of exactly 100000 dollars takes the 1000-dollar minimum; a hypothetical limit of 100100 dollars takes the 1250-dollar minimum.
- The minimum contents deductible is 1000 dollars on every tier, and the highest amount that may be elected on either coverage is 10000 dollars.
- The default building deductible is 2000 dollars (0 on the Tenant Contents tier) and the default contents deductible is 2000 dollars on every tier.
